mapper.update: UPDATE sys_module SET path = CONCAT(#{newPath}, SUBSTRING(path, #{oldPathLength} + 1)) WHERE path LIKE CONCAT(#{oldPath}, '/%')
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM SYS_MODULE m JOIN SYS_ROLE_MODULE rm ON m.ID = rm.MODULE_ID JOIN SYS_ROLE r ON r.ID = rm.ROLE_ID JOIN SYS_ROLEUSER_REF ru ON r.ID = ru.ROLE_ID WHERE ru.USER_ID = #{userId} AND (m.DELETED = 0 OR m.DELETED IS NULL) AND (m.FROZEN != 1 OR m.FROZEN IS NULL) ORDER BY m.sort ASC

SELECT * FROM v_granted_module m
and role_Code in
#{code,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and m.pid = 0
and m.name like
concat('%',#{condition,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
'%' ||#{condition}||'%'
'%' || #{condition, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
and m.name like
concat('%',#{module.name,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
'%'||#{module.name}||'%'
'%' || #{module.name, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
ORDER BY m.sort ASC

SELECT
FROM SYS_MODULE SM
and SM.pid = 0
and SM.pid = #{module.pid,jdbcType=BIGINT}
and SM.name like
concat('%',#{module.name,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
'%'||#{module.name}||'%'
'%' || #{module.name, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
and SM.code = #{module.code,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
ORDER BY SM.sort ASC, SM.ID ASC

SELECT
FROM sys_module SM WHERE SM.pid = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY SM.sort ASC, SM.ID ASC
SELECT * FROM sys_module module WHERE module.id = (SELECT pid FROM sys_module og WHERE og.id = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT}) ORDER BY module.sort ASC

SELECT
ifnull(max(sort),0)
nvl(max(sort),0)
coalesce(max(sort), 0)
FROM sys_module WHERE pid = #{pid,jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_module SET frozen = 1 WHERE id = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT} OR path like concat(#{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '/%') OR path like concat('%/', #{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '/%') OR path like concat('%/', #{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.ID, m.SORT, m.NAME, m.PID, m.PATH, m.ISLEAF, m.CODE, m.ICON, m.ROUTE_URL, m.COMPONENT_URL FROM SYS_ROLEUSER_REF ru JOIN SYS_ROLERES_REF rr ON ru.ROLE_ID = rr.ROLE_ID JOIN SYS_MODULE_RESOURCES r ON rr.RESOURCE_ID = r.ID AND (r.DELETED = 0 OR r.DELETED IS NULL) JOIN SYS_MODULE m ON r.MAIN_ID = m.ID WHERE ru.USER_ID = #{uid} AND (m.DELETED = 0 OR m.DELETED IS NULL) ORDER BY m.SORT ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_module SET path = REPLACE(path, #{oldPathId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{newPathId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) WHERE path like concat('%', #{oldPathId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%') AND id != CAST(#{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS BIGINT)

UPDATE sys_module SET PATH = REPLACE(PATH, #{oldModule.path,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{newModule.path,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) WHERE path like
concat('%',#{oldModule.path,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
'%'||#{oldModule.path}||'%'
'%' || #{oldModule.path, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND id != #{oldModule.id,jdbcType=BIGINT}
